name: flocon
description: Connects your AI agent to the Flocon Desktop MCP server: network calls, mocks, files, analytics events and databases of your mobile app

interface.shortDescription: Debug your mobile app with Flocon
interface.longDescription: Inspect and mock the network calls of your mobile app, and read its files, analytics events and databases through Flocon Desktop. Flocon Desktop must be running.
defaultPrompt: List the failed network calls of my app and explain why they fail
Make the login call return a 500 so I can check the error screen
Check in the database that the user I just created is saved correctly
